title.zh-TW: Anthropic 掛牌首日收漲逾17%，美股四大指數仍跌逾2%
title.en: Anthropic closes up over 17% on debut as major US indexes fall more than 2%

summary.zh-TW: CBS 報導，Anthropic 以每股83美元發行9.8億股，募資813億美元，為史上最大 IPO，於那斯達克以 ANT 掛牌。中央社彙整外電，ANT 開盤後一度突破110美元，收在97.17美元；但道瓊、標普500、那斯達克及費城半導體指數19日均跌逾2%，費半跌2.41%。
summary.en: CBS reports Anthropic sold 980 million shares at US$83, raising US$81.3 billion in the largest IPO on record, listing on Nasdaq as ANT. CNA, citing wires, says ANT briefly topped US$110 and closed at US$97.17, yet the Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq and the Philadelphia semiconductor index all fell more than 2% on Nov. 19, the SOX down 2.41%.

impact.zh-TW: 新股熱度未能扭轉科技股賣壓，顯示資金對 AI 題材評價分歧；美股半導體下跌可能延續影響台股電子權值股開盤，此為推論。
impact.en: Strong demand for the new listing did not reverse tech selling, pointing to divided views on AI valuations; the US chip slide may weigh on Taiwan's electronics heavyweights at the open, which is an inference.

title.zh-TW: 台股19日重挫1768點，跌破4萬點與年線
title.en: Taiex plunges 1,768 points on Nov. 19, closing below 40,000 and its 240-day line

summary.zh-TW: 焦點台灣報導，加權指數19日跌4.4%收38,426.89點，為史上第七大收盤跌點，跌破約39,368點的年線，成交值8,952.8億元。台積電跌3.45%至2,100元，聯發科、南亞科、緯穎等跌幅較大，櫃買指數跌7.22%，外資賣超243.1億元。
summary.en: Focus Taiwan reports the Taiex fell 4.4% to 38,426.89 on Nov. 19, its seventh-largest point drop at a close, breaking the 240-day average near 39,368 on NT$895.3 billion turnover. TSMC fell 3.45% to NT$2,100; MediaTek, Nanya Technology and Wiwynn fell harder, the OTC index lost 7.22%, and foreign investors net sold NT$24.3 billion.

impact.zh-TW: 報導引述分析師，市場擔憂 AI 循環融資收緊、供應鏈利潤分配及輝達成本控管可能壓縮台廠毛利；此為觀點而非已發生事實，短線波動仍大。
impact.en: An analyst cited worries over tighter AI circular financing, supply-chain profit sharing and possible Nvidia cost controls squeezing Taiwan suppliers' margins; these are views, not realized outcomes, and volatility remains high.

title.zh-TW: 金管會加碼限空措施，11月20日起實施
title.en: Taiwan's FSC tightens short-selling curbs from Nov. 20

summary.zh-TW: 中央社報導，金管會宣布自20日起，上市櫃股票或 TDR 當日收盤跌幅達3.5%者，次一營業日融券及借券賣出不得低於前日收盤價；借券賣出每日委託上限由30日均量3%降至1%，並鼓勵金融業買進及券商穩定市場。金管會未設結束日期，將視情勢調整。
summary.en: CNA reports that from Nov. 20, any listed or OTC stock or TDR closing down 3.5% or more cannot be short sold below the prior close the next trading day, and the daily securities-lending sell cap drops from 3% to 1% of 30-day average volume. Financial firms are encouraged to buy and dealers to stabilize prices. No end date was set.

impact.zh-TW: 限空可減緩短線賣壓擴散，但無法改變外部科技股走勢與外資動向；措施成效需觀察後續成交量與波動，非保證止跌。
impact.en: The curbs may slow short-term selling pressure but cannot change overseas tech trends or foreign flows; their effect depends on coming volume and volatility and does not guarantee a floor.

title.zh-TW: 輝達第三季營收1158億美元，下季展望1300億美元
title.en: Nvidia posts US$115.8 billion Q3 revenue, guides US$130 billion next quarter

summary.zh-TW: 輝達公布截至10月25日的2027財年第三季財報：營收1158億美元，年增103%；資料中心營收1076億美元，年增110%；GAAP 毛利率74.8%。第四季營收展望1300億美元上下3%（含多一週），毛利率71%至72%，並未計入中國資料中心運算營收。代理執行長由財務長 Kress 兼任。
summary.en: Nvidia reported fiscal Q3 2027 (to Oct. 25) revenue of US$115.8 billion, up 103% year on year, with data center revenue of US$107.6 billion, up 110%, and a 74.8% GAAP gross margin. It guided Q4 revenue of US$130 billion plus or minus 3% (including an extra week) and 71%-72% margins, assuming no China data center compute revenue. CFO Kress is interim CEO.

impact.zh-TW: 營收與展望為公司公布數字，但下季毛利率指引低於本季，加上領導層更替，市場關注供應鏈議價與成本壓力；台廠訂單變化尚未證實。
impact.en: The figures and guidance are company-reported, but the lower margin outlook plus the leadership change has the market watching supplier pricing and costs; any change in Taiwan suppliers' orders is unconfirmed.

title.zh-TW: 輝達停售 H200 晶片給中國，北京重申既有立場
title.en: Nvidia stops H200 chip sales to China; Beijing restates its position

summary.zh-TW: 聯合報編譯外電，輝達代理執行長 Kress 17日表示停止對中國銷售 H200，先前美方可抽成25%的出口安排隨之終止；輝達同日成立董事會層級委員會監督國安與出口管制合規。太報報導，中國外交部發言人18日僅稱已多次闡明立場。Jefferies 估美方新規恐使輝達明年資料中心營收減少440億至620億美元。
summary.en: UDN, citing foreign reports, says interim CEO Kress said on Nov. 17 that Nvidia stopped H200 sales to China, ending a deal giving the US a 25% cut; Nvidia also formed a board committee on export compliance. Taisounds says China's foreign ministry on Nov. 18 cited its stated position. Jefferies estimates new US rules could cut Nvidia's data center revenue next year by US$44-62 billion.

impact.zh-TW: 中國高階 AI 晶片需求由輝達供應的管道再收窄，Jefferies 數字屬券商預估；對台灣代工、封測與伺服器供應鏈的實際影響仍待公司說明。
impact.en: Nvidia's channel for high-end AI chips into China narrows further; the Jefferies figure is a broker estimate, and the actual effect on Taiwan's foundry, packaging and server suppliers awaits company disclosures.

sources.publisher: 太報 via Yahoo奇摩新聞

reason.zh-TW: 報導指台積電19日跌3.45%至2,100元並跌破年線，占台股市值逾四成；輝達財報與對中停售 H200 為其 AI 晶片代工需求的觀察線索，屬產業推論。
reason.en: TSMC fell 3.45% to NT$2,100 on Nov. 19, below its 240-day line, and is over 40% of local market cap; Nvidia's results and its China H200 halt are signals to watch for AI foundry demand, an industry inference.

risk.zh-TW: 權值比重高，外資賣超與美國科技股修正易放大波動；出口管制變化可能影響客戶出貨。
risk.en: Its heavy index weight means foreign selling and US tech corrections can amplify swings; export-control changes may affect customer shipments.

reason.zh-TW: 報導指聯發科19日跌5.58%至3,720元，跌幅大於大盤；美股費半同日再跌2.41%，可觀察 IC 設計股評價調整。
reason.en: MediaTek fell 5.58% to NT$3,720 on Nov. 19, more than the market; with the SOX down another 2.41% the same day, IC design valuations are worth watching.

risk.zh-TW: 高價股易受限空與外資調節影響，AI 相關評價修正可能延續。
risk.en: High-priced shares are sensitive to short-selling rules and foreign rebalancing; AI-related valuation resets may continue.

sector.zh-TW: 電腦及週邊／AI 伺服器

reason.zh-TW: 報導指緯穎等伺服器股19日跌逾4%；輝達資料中心營收年增110%，但市場擔憂成本控管壓縮供應鏈毛利，屬產業推論。
reason.en: Wiwynn and other server names fell over 4% on Nov. 19; Nvidia's data center revenue rose 110%, but the market worries cost controls could squeeze supplier margins, an industry inference.

risk.zh-TW: 雲端客戶資本支出節奏、毛利壓力與高評價回落風險；未有報導證實訂單變化。
risk.en: Risks include cloud customers' capex timing, margin pressure and de-rating of high valuations; no report confirms order changes.

reason.zh-TW: 報導指南亞科19日跌逾9%至293.5元，為跌幅較重的記憶體股；可觀察限空措施實施後的波動變化。
reason.en: Nanya Technology fell more than 9% to NT$293.50 on Nov. 19, among the hardest-hit memory names; volatility after the new short-selling curbs is worth watching.

risk.zh-TW: 記憶體價格循環與 AI 需求預期反轉風險，單日波動大。
risk.en: Memory price cycles and shifting AI demand expectations; daily swings are large.

sector.zh-TW: 其他電子／AI 伺服器組裝

reason.zh-TW: 報導指鴻海19日僅跌0.23%至220.5元，相對抗跌；其 AI 伺服器業務與輝達資料中心需求相關，屬產業推論。
reason.en: Hon Hai fell only 0.23% to NT$220.50 on Nov. 19, holding up relatively well; its AI server business ties to Nvidia data center demand, an industry inference.

risk.zh-TW: 組裝毛利偏低，若客戶加強成本控管可能受壓；中國相關出口限制亦增不確定性。
risk.en: Assembly margins are thin and could be pressured if customers tighten costs; China-related export limits add uncertainty.
